mechanism_narrative: The level of FEDFUNDS is inversely related to S&P 500 forward returns; a lower FEDFUNDS level (as observed at 4.33%) is associated with positive 20-day returns due to reduced discount rates and lower risk premia.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day S&P 500 returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 3.2 (annualized inflation rate) signals a high inflation environment that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days due to central bank tightening and reduced equity valuation multiples.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.2, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS (indicating monetary tightening) and CPIAUCSL (indicating inflation) signals a 'dove' monetary policy cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days due to heightened economic uncertainty and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise (3-month change > 0), or the Rank IC between the joint signal and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market, indicated by UNRATE below 4.0% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% per month, signals strong economic activity and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% per month, or the Rank IC between the joint signal and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST level below 1400 (thousands of units) signals weak housing market activity and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The level of RSAFS (residential fixed investment) is positively related to S&P 500 forward returns; a higher RSAFS level (as observed at 722708.0 million dollars) indicates strong housing market activity and economic growth, leading to positive 60-day returns.
failure_condition: The correlation between RSAFS level and 60-day S&P 500 returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in INDPRO (industrial production) and HOUST (housing starts) signals a broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO and HOUST both decline (3-month change < 0), or the Rank IC between the joint signal and 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST level above 1600 (thousands of units) signals strong housing market activity and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 1600, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5-day returns is not significantly positive (p>0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
